title: Lotería de los Pueblos — Look & Feel

Play.dc.html.title: 3 · El cantor canta: elige la correcta

title.text: Feria de noche — a lotería night-fair look

how.text: Core loop: the automatic cantor calls one card in the player's language. Three picture choices appear; tapping the right one places a bean on the tabla (if it's there). Wrong taps get a gentle ¡Casi! and a second try — never a penalty.

honesty.text: Nahuatl words are the deck's documented drafts (tonatiuh, metztli, centli…) and always carry the 'palabra en revisión' tag until a native speaker approves them.
